description: This file defines a deprecated reporter interface and a function to bridge between Ginkgo V1 and V2 reporting formats, including handling of test suite and spec reports.

classes.name: DeprecatedReporter
classes.description: Interface for deprecated V1 custom reporters, with methods for suite and spec lifecycle events.

methods.name: ReportViaDeprecatedReporter
methods.description: Bridges V2 report data to a V1 deprecated reporter, transforming suite and spec reports accordingly.

methods.name: failureFor
methods.description: Constructs a DeprecatedSpecFailure object based on a SpecReport's failure details.
